They give the birefringence 0.1171 at 1.064 µm quoted on the same page, and the paper uses them for SHG down to 158 nm (shortest type-I SH wavelength, xy plane; 157.5 nm from these equations). Nature 650, 97 (2026) refined the equations against DUV phase-matching angles (158.9–235 nm) but does not print the coefficients; its type-I xy-plane curve (Source Data, Fig. 2c) gives φ = 88.8° for SHG of 318.3 nm where these equations give 83.2°, and 16.7° at 1.09 µm where they give 15.9°, so near the VUV edge these 2017 equations are only approximate
